title: Airway Coach Project: Prediction of Videolaryngoscopy Strategy With Clinical and Ultrasound Parameters (Unicentric)
official: Airway Coach Project: Prediction of Videolaryngoscopy Strategy With Clinical and Ultrasound Parameters (Unicentric)
summary: This unicentric observational study collects clinical characteristics, demographic data, and point-of-care airway ultrasound measurements in patients undergoing videolaryngoscopy. These variables are analysed using machine-learning techniques to examine their association with predefined videolaryngoscopy-related outcomes, including blade performance and adjunct requirement.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients (male or female) ASA I-III, aged between 18 and 90 years, undergoing scheduled surgery requiring orotracheal intubation. The signature of the informed consent is required authorizing its inclusion in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Obesity class II defined as a BMI greater than 35.
* Pregnant.
* Cervical tumors, goiter or patients who have required radiotherapy at the cervical level
* Abnormalities that condition anatomy alterations such as facial / cervical fractures.
* Maxillofacial abnormalities
* People who cannot give their consent
